text:
kai: Heads up — we need GCP quota increases in us-west1 for a Dedicated GPU pool we're provisioning for customer 'Nimbus'. Planning window: need baseline by 2026-04-10, with short bursts possible the following 6 weeks.

maria: Can you list the exact quotas you want bumped? GPUs, vCPUs, IPs, forwarding rules, PDs? Also which project ID?

kai: Project is redwood-dedicated-nimbus-usw1. Required increases (initial ask):
- GPUs (A100 80GB equiv): baseline 24 -> request 48 (allow burst to 72)
- vCPU regional quota: +1024 cores
- Persistent Disk SSD (PD-SSD): +40 TB
- Static external IP addresses: +30
- Forwarding rules / global address quota for LB: +10
- VM instances (regional): +200 instances (we only expect ~60, but need headroom)

jonathan: Quick note — GCP enforces accelerator quota per GPU family and per region. Make sure to ask for the specific accelerator type (a100-80gb) and across the zones we plan to use (us-west1-a,b,c). Also ask for a per-zone soft limit if they still enforce it.

maria: Timeline? who will open the support case? GCP support turnaround varies. We should include the billing account and justify throughput.

kai: Target date 2026-04-10 for baseline. Will open the support case today. Justification: Dedicated pool for production inference -> sustained 24 GPUs and occasional burst to 72 to handle traffic spikes for onboarding + canary rollouts; we plan to reserve capacity behind RBAC for Nimbus.

infra-bot: Reminder: please attach the project billing account, organization ID, and the support tag "quota increase - accelerators" when opening the case.

jonathan: Also request increases for the following networking quotas — they often block LB provisioning:
- Forwarding rules (global) +10
- In-use static addresses (regional) +30
- External IP addresses (regional) +30
- Routes per project +500

kai: Adding a short cost estimate for review: baseline 24 A100s, assuming spot/ondemand mix -> rough incremental infra run-rate ~ $20k/day (estimate, varies by provider & commitment). Finance, please confirm. @eve

eve: I'll run precise numbers but agree we should consider committed use/reservation to reduce unit costs if this runs sustained. Also need to factor in storage and egress for model downloads.

maria: Ops question: do we need a soft reservation in the provider (e.g., committed use) before quota is granted? I think quota is separate but reservations reduce price.

jonathan: Correct — quota is permission to create resources; reservations/commitments are separate purchases. For Dedicated pools, we create a reservation in our infra layer after quota is approved. Recommend requesting quota + a note that we'll pursue reservations once quotas are granted.

kai: Draft support-case body below — please review and copy into GCP console.

kai: ```
Project ID: redwood-dedicated-nimbus-usw1
Organization ID: 123456789012
Billing account: 01A2BC-XXXXX
Region: us-west1 (zones a,b,c)
Requested increases:
- GPUs (NVIDIA A100 80GB equiv, accelerator type a100-80gb): current 8 -> request 72 (24 baseline + 48 burst)
- Compute vCPU (region): current 256 -> request 1280
- Persistent Disk SSD (GB): current 5000 -> request 45000
- In-use static IP addresses (regional): current 4 -> request 34
- Forwarding rules (global): current 8 -> request 18
- VM instances (regional): current 20 -> request 220
Justification: Dedicated inference pool for a commercial customer (Nimbus). We will run a production inference fleet with sustained traffic, need headroom for canaries and traffic bursts over the next 6-8 weeks. We have a billing account and will provide payment contact for verification.
Need-by date: 2026-04-10
Contact: kai@redwood.com, maria@redwood.com
```

maria: This looks good. Add a note asking whether the accelerator quota can be applied cluster-wide vs per-zone; request mirrored increases for all three zones.

kai: Added.

oncall: Assigning to cloud-accounts team. I'll open the case and paste the template. Setting priority P2 given customer SLA.

jonathan: Also file a parallel request for internal quota cards: gcloud commands to validate after increases:```
# list quotas for region
gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-dedicated-nimbus-usw1
# list accelerator quota per zone
gcloud compute accelerator-types list --zones=us-west1-a,us-west1-b,us-west1-c --project=redwood-dedicated-nimbus-usw1
```

kai: Action items:
- oncall: open support case using template and tag cloud-accounts + infra-ops (due today) :rocket:
- jonathan: confirm exact accelerator-type names & zone mapping and include in the case (due today)
- eve: quick cost check on daily run-rate and reservation guidance (due EOD)
- maria: validate RBAC and tenancy controls for the Nimbus Dedicated pool (due 2026-04-05)

maria: Sounds good. We'll also keep 10% headroom in our pool config to avoid immediate re-requests. :thumbsup:

kai: Thanks all — I'll post the support-case link and keep this thread updated.

infra-bot: Support case opened: CASE-2026-1398 (cloud-accounts). Status: Pending reply from GCP.

jonathan: Once they approve, let's stagger the capacity ramp over 48 hours to avoid API rate shocks and to watch health metrics.

kai: Agreed. I'll schedule the reservation create and canary rollouts.

eve: I'll send a short note to finance about the expected commit and potential options for committed use discounts.

maria: Closing loop — thanks everyone, keep updates here.
